label: ask
reason: the guard's sheet: its answer is the outcome of the command that asked (a declined sheet ends a close or a reload `cancelled`, views.ts endRefused), never an input of its own

label: restartAlertBox
reason: A5.1 #17's alert when a restart failed: one button, Quit, on a window already gone; no choice to record, and the restart's failure is `update`'s own `restart-failed` line

label: app:ready
reason: no input: a page saying it has loaded

label: settings:get
reason: no input: Settings reading the files to draw itself

label: tab:menu-pick
reason: no input of its own (spec 32 B2): the strip's menu pick runs exactly what the native click ran, so the one command is the one tabAct opens (TAB_MENU or OVERFLOW); a null pick runs nothing

label: tab:menu-shown
reason: no input (spec 32 B2): the strip saying the menu is on screen, which ends the held tab-menu or tabs-more command
